_doc: r29-inject-recomb (register row 1, R1-1/m8), 2026-11-04.  The searched (field-recombined) product of every field-repair record of r8inputs/v409/fieldfix_v409.json, same order: its own S_min, rms, EIRP, on-source time, integration count and per-field geometry (offset, Gaussian response at the extractor's 1.22 lambda/D, on-source time, integrations, summed a_rel^2-scaled weight), read from the product files on the cluster (paths + md5).  Read by recombfold_r30.py (limits), v342_calc.py (primary beam, integration count), pbaudit_v408.py (provenance), beam_r17.py (mosaic retention) and pxapply_v411.py (apparent-position products).
